note: Set A is the cleaner extraction: it binds the (2) 2-1/4" heavy hex nuts to the 3-1/2" steel rod correctly and keeps the FIRST FLR elevation conditioned on GRADE LEVEL, while Set B additionally claims a 3-1/2" steel rod diameter (the rod is 2-1/4" dia A36; 3-1/2" is a length/other dimension) and pads its list with three vague 'detail typ / component' dimension claims and five duplicate restatements. Both sets share the same core errors: a fabricated 'TYP 1/4"' quote, '3/8"' plate thickness misbound as a weld size, and the ambiguous '2 5/16" HOLE' reading. Set A's main weaknesses are invented location/detail conditions (Detail A5, grid 1 and A, 'Structure South Elevation - Main') and it omits the (1) 2-1/4" heavy hex nut of the pin connection that Set B captures.
remarks: Both sets miss the notable spec note '2 1/4" DIA. A36 THREADED ROD OF VARYING LENGTHS TO ACCOMODATE UP TO 12" ELEVATION DIFFERENCE' and the keeper-plate/teflon/neoprene pad details. The text 'W/ 2 5/16" HOLE' is genuinely ambiguous (2 holes @ 5/16" vs one 2-5/16" hole) and both sets read it the same way. '3X 1/4 DIAGONAL BRACE' is also ambiguous (3 braces of 1/4" plate vs a weld call) and both sets label it a weld size.
